Find the shortest path between two objects via reference relationships.



Traverses relationships following reference fields (*_ref, *_refs) to find

a connection path between the two objects.

  Find path from one backlog item to another
  zqk object path ITEM-626 ITEM-641
  Output as JSON
  zqk object path ITEM-626 ITEM-641 --format json
  Output as YAML
  zqk object path ITEM-626 ITEM-641 --format yaml

Usage:
  zqk object path [flags]

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
